entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer that when running prevents UE from starting registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update except under specific conditions.

entities.name: Timer T3447
entities.description: Timer that when running prevents UE from starting mobility and periodic registration update procedure with Uplink data status IE or Follow-on request indicator set to 'Follow-on request pending' except under specific conditions.

entities.name: Timer T3448
entities.description: Timer that when running prevents UE in 5GMM-IDLE mode from starting mobility and periodic registration update procedure with Follow-on request indicator set to 'Follow-on request pending' except under specific conditions.

entities.name: Timer T3510
entities.description: Timer that shall be stopped if still running in certain abnormal cases.

entities.name: Timer T3511
entities.description: Timer started in abnormal cases to trigger registration update procedure again when it expires.

entities.name: Timer T3502
entities.description: Timer started when registration attempt counter reaches 5.

entities.name: Registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update
entities.description: Procedure for UE to update its registration with the network for mobility and periodic updates.

entities.name: De-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to de-register from the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE
entities.description: State entered when UE attempts registration update after abnormal cases.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: State entered when registration update is successful.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: Optional state entered when registration attempt counter reaches 5 to perform PLMN selection.

entities.name: Access barred indication
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate that access attempt is barred.

entities.name: Change in current TAI
entities.description: Condition where Tracking Area Identity changes before registration procedure completion.

entities.name: 5GS update status set to 5U2 NOT UPDATED
entities.description: Property where UE sets 5GS update status to NOT UPDATED in various abnormal cases.

relations.description: Timer T3346 running prevents starting registration procedure except under specific conditions.
Timer T3447 running prevents starting mobility and periodic registration update procedure with specific IEs set.
Timer T3448 running prevents UE in 5GMM-IDLE mode from starting mobility and periodic registration update procedure with Follow-on request indicator set.
Access barred indication prevents starting registration procedure.
TAI change before registration completion causes procedure abortion and re-initiation.
TAI change establishes 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED.
Registration procedure requires state 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE in certain abnormal cases.
Registration procedure with attempt counter 5 optionally requires state 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.
Registration procedure collision with de-registration procedure determines which procedure progresses.
Timer T3511 starts to trigger registration update procedure again when it expires.
Timer T3510 stops if still running in certain abnormal cases.
